svg.text: Underside view (case off, plate upside down). Grey line = inner wall, grey discs = wall bosses, red = floor pillars (never run a wire over one), yellow = pads.
Blue = column wires, orange = row wires: the shield's matrix. Rows count from the top (0-2 the key rows, 3 the extra keys, 4 the thumbs), columns from the pinky.
Thin lines: each chain's wire to its nice!nano pin. The nano sits component side down with its USB at the wall, so its pins read as in the pinout drawing.
Dashed: the bay and the reset/power pockets (those two live in the plate). Reset → RST + GND; battery + → power switch → RAW/B+; battery − → GND.
Rows → pro_micro 20/19/18/16/10 (pacino.dtsi), columns → 9/8/7/6/5 (pacino_left.overlay). Left half shown; the right half is the mirror image.
